description: Functional specifications/files: integrate credential operations into PeopleAuthGateway fixed confidential Engine boundary; PeopleAuth authenticates bearer and PeoplePermissions authorizes; PersonCredentials remains domain projection/mutation and no caller-supplied Person authority. Tests first: forged/revoked/expired session, permission withdrawal, inactive/merged identity, cross-owner input, safe DTO/error. Branches: list/status/put/revoke/remove. Mocking: real auth/Repo/encryption. Docs: Engine/system config. Action reuse: extend existing gateway and domain API; no Action/tool exposure.
title: [zaq-jrg.13] Authenticate self-service credential operations
